events.title: Hamas attacks Israel - Gaza War begins
events.indiaImpact: Oil prices surge. Indian diaspora in Gulf affected. Air India reroutes flights.

events.title: Israel declares war on Hamas
events.indiaImpact: Crude oil rises 5%. India monitors closely - large Indian community in Israel.

events.title: Israel strikes Iranian consulate in Damascus
events.indiaImpact: Oil prices spike. India urges restraint. Indian workers in Gulf on alert.

events.title: Iran launches 300+ drones and missiles at Israel
events.indiaImpact: Strait of Hormuz tension. 80%+ of India oil imports pass through Gulf. Fuel prices spike.

events.title: Hamas leader Ismail Haniyeh assassinated in Tehran
events.indiaImpact: Escalation fears. Indian govt advisory for Gulf region.

events.title: Israel pager/walkie-talkie attack on Hezbollah Lebanon
events.indiaImpact: Shock attack. Lebanese Indian community on high alert.

events.title: Israel-Lebanon ceasefire signed
events.indiaImpact: Temporary relief. Oil prices ease slightly.

events.title: Assad regime falls - Syria changes hands
events.indiaImpact: Regional power shift. India recalibrates Middle East policy.

events.title: Israel resumes Gaza offensive - ceasefire collapses
events.indiaImpact: Oil prices rise. Air India Pakistan airspace issues continue.

events.title: Israel launches Operation Rising Lion - strikes Iran
events.indiaImpact: Strait of Hormuz partially disrupted. Indian oil tankers rerouted. Jet fuel costs up.

events.title: 12-Day War ends - US-Israel ceasefire with Iran
events.indiaImpact: Crude oil falls back. Indian diaspora in Gulf relief. Pakistan airspace still closed.

events.title: Gaza ceasefire - October 2025
events.indiaImpact: Regional tension eases. India humanitarian aid to Gaza.

events.title: Iran protests begin - currency collapse, inflation
events.indiaImpact: Iran instability watched closely. Indian trade with Iran affected by sanctions.

events.title: Iran internet blackout - mass protest crackdown
events.indiaImpact: Indian govt issues advisory. Gulf Indian community monitoring situation.

events.title: US deploys largest Middle East military buildup since 2003
events.indiaImpact: Oil market volatility. India on alert for Strait of Hormuz closure risk.

events.title: US and Israel launch strikes on Iran - 2026 Iran War begins
events.indiaImpact: CRITICAL: Strait of Hormuz disrupted. Oil hits $120/barrel. Air India Gulf routes affected. Indian diaspora 3.5M in Gulf region.

events.title: Iran launches retaliatory missiles at Israel and US bases in Gulf
events.indiaImpact: Gulf airports disrupted. Dubai, Doha, Bahrain bases attacked. Indian flights rerouted.

events.title: Multi-front war - Lebanon, Iraq, Yemen all activated
events.indiaImpact: Shipping through Red Sea and Hormuz severely disrupted. India import costs surging.

events.title: Ongoing: US-Iran war continues - ceasefire talks stalled
events.indiaImpact: Oil remains at $120+/barrel. Fuel prices in India elevated. Indian diplomats working backchannel. 9M Indian diaspora in Gulf watching closely.
